turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Mr. Tan, how are you feeling now after the surgery? Any pain or discomfort?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling okay, Doctor. Got a bit of discomfort here and there, but not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate your pain right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 3 or 4, lah. It's manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Have you been feeling nauseous or sick to your stomach at all?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, no nausea. I'm a bit thirsty, but that's about it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Are you breathing comfortably? Any tightness or difficulty breathing?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, Doctor. No problem there.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Did you experience any awareness or discomfort during the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't remember anything. I was out cold.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Given your hypertension and diabetes, we'll keep a close eye on your vitals and blood sugar levels. Any concerns or questions?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, Doctor. I think that's all. Thank you.
